reason: Both are legible comparison sheets, but 32cc11 carries a stronger, more deliberate visual identity plus the depot-coverage map that makes the on-site fitting criterion tangible, while d178d1 is plainer and its sticky action bar visibly overlaps a supplier row.

033fcb reads as a genuine tender evaluation sheet with per-row scales that plot all three suppliers on one axis and an adjustable cost model, whereas 32cc11 leans on repetitive BEST/RISK badges over a dark ground that a fleet manager would struggle to print or scan.

Both are exceptional; 033fcb wins on restraint and pace, keeping one clear argument per band, while ede597 crowds four colour-coded annotation systems into a very long page that tires before the award.

ede597 is far more complete and more beautifully set, carrying the comparison through weighted scoring to an actual signed award record, while d178d1 stops at a plain table and ships a visible overlap defect.

033fcb has the sharper typographic hierarchy and shows its working with in-row scales and an editable model, where d178d1's criterion table is generic and its floating bar covers content in the full view.

ede597 gives the client the whole decision, from criteria to weighting to the recorded award, with more assured typography, while 32cc11's dark treatment and badge-heavy grid feel more like a dashboard than a document to sign.
